description: Hide a connector's tools from the active tool list for the current user. Use when the user says they don't use a service or wants to pause a connector, such as 'disable Shopify' or 'hide TikTok'. The connector remains configured and can be restored with enable_connector. Disabled connectors still appear in get_connector_status marked Paused.

connector_id.description: Connector ID to disable. Examples: shopify, tiktok, ebay, microsoft, slack, google_ads, quickbooks, klaviyo.

name: disable_connector
title: Disable Connector
